note: Triennial election of the rural district council (29 divisions), 1930: nominations received by W. B. O'Donohue, deputy returning officer, 29 April 1930. No nomination in Belleek either, where the old member John McDermott had been disqualified for non-attendance, so the new council was to co-opt. The other sitting members returned unopposed (15 divisions) are not named in the reports read. Returned unopposed. New member, replacing P. J. Murphy. Labels of the three new members not printed; the Newry Telegraph does not give them.
